items.title: Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Chick Corea — I think he liked Chick Corea right away. In fact that’s how I learned “Spain,” I heard them playing and I says gee I played that on the classical guitar.

ctx.x: Was he influenced by what, The Beatles, or even more recent people?

I don’t know, everybody. Chick Corea — I think he liked Chick Corea right away. In fact that’s how I learned “Spain,” I heard them playing and I says gee I played that on the classical guitar. That’s where it’s from Concierto de Aranjuez by Rodrigo.
What was his attitude toward what you do? Did he realize how much playing you had done up to that point?
